fib: ______ is used in determining rates of change, in determining minimum and maximum values in arithmetic and in determining areas of plane shapes.
Differential calculus is used in determining rates of change, in determining minimum and maximum values in arithmetic and in determining areas of plane shapes.
______ is the ratio of the number of times of the event and the number of total possible outcomes of experiment of the experiment.
Probability of an event is the ratio of the number of times of the event and the number of total possible outcomes of experiment of the experiment.

Pie chart is a way of presenting data on a cycle and frequency polygon is a way presenting data on a graph with successive points joined by straight lines.
______ is a statement equating two or more quantities.

______ is considered the strongest and most reliable measure of central location followed by the median.
